query:
SELECT s.name, p.label, pf.openingStock, pf.arrivals, pf.invoiced, im.value as ims
FROM skus s
JOIN periods p ON 1=1
LEFT JOIN planning_fg_data pf ON pf.skuId = s.id AND pf.periodId = p.id
LEFT JOIN ims_data im ON im.skuId = s.id AND im.periodId = p.id
WHERE s.name LIKE '%Blueberry Mint%' AND s.weight = '50g' AND p.year = 2025
ORDER BY p.year, p.month;
